title: Nursing, Midwifery & Health Training Colleges Admission
description: The sequential roadmap to apply to public and military nursing colleges in Ghana—from Ministry of Health voucher purchasing to college entrance interviews and Nursing & Midwifery Council (NMC) student indexing.

steps.title: Purchase Voucher & Apply on Ministry of Health HTI Portal
steps.why: The Ministry of Health centralised portal coordinates all public applications for registered general nursing, midwifery, community health, and allied nursing diplomas.
steps.do_this_when: During the official MOH application window (typically February to June).

options.label: Health Training Institutions (HTI) Admission Portal
options.notes: Official portal for nursing and midwifery training college admission vouchers.

steps.title: Select Preferred Nursing & Midwifery Training College
steps.why: Applicants must select their primary and secondary institutions and review specific campus interview requirements and cut-off grades.
steps.do_this_when: When filling in college preferences on the HTI portal.

options.label: Korle-Bu Nurses and Midwives Training College
options.notes: Admissions requirements for Korle-Bu training college.

options.label: 37 Military Hospital Nursing and Midwifery Training College
options.notes: Military hospital nursing diploma requirements and interview guidelines.

options.label: Pantang Nurses and Midwives Training College
Koforidua Nurses and Midwives Training College
options.notes: Eastern Region nursing and midwifery admissions information.

steps.title: Complete Nursing & Midwifery Council (NMC) Student Indexing
steps.why: Upon admission, every student nurse and midwife must be formally indexed by the Nursing and Midwifery Council of Ghana to be registered for council examinations.
steps.do_this_when: During the first semester of matriculation.

options.label: Nursing and Midwifery Council Student Indexing Portal
options.notes: Official NMC student indexing form and documentation verification.
